decisive_items: His mother had systemic lupus erythematosus treated with hydroxychloroquine and low-dose prednisolone and was positive for anti-SSa/Ro and anti-SSb/La antibodies
antibody testing confirmed high-titer antinuclear antibodies (>1:1000) and 52-kD anti-SSa/Ro and anti-SSb/La positivity
response.rationale: Neonatal lupus is more likely due to the mother's history of systemic lupus erythematosus and the infant's positive antibody tests, despite some findings consistent with bronchopulmonary dysplasia

rejected.why: Low heart rate is not sufficient to confirm congenital heart block, and other findings do not strongly support this diagnosis
